title: TaskSpec
description: A research task and its sealed acquisition plan. Split into two blocks on purpose: 'treatment_visible' is everything an arm is allowed to see, and 'acquisition_spec' is steward-only. The acquisition spec contains authored facets and conflict/negative probes -- handing those to a selector would give P1 a decomposition of the question that P0 never received, which would make any measured advantage an artifact of the harness rather than of the P1 mechanism.

split.description: The FORMATIVE_ prefixes are load-bearing: this round's corpus is machine-authored and its splits may support screening and design choices only. A confirmatory study needs a new sealed registry, and its splits would carry different names for exactly that reason.

cluster_id.description: Topic + source cluster. This, not the task, is the primary independent unit for inference: tasks sharing sources are correlated, and splitting them across SCREEN/HOLDOUT would leak.

deployment_pins.description: Permitted only if these exact bytes also appear in the P0 task prompt. Otherwise this is extra planning information for one arm.

acquisition_spec.description: STEWARD-ONLY. Sealed before any source fetch and never re-derived afterwards -- refining it post-acquisition would let the corpus be shaped to favour an arm.

fixed_queries.description: Frozen at registry seal. Queries may NOT be added in response to a P0 or P1 output.

authoring_method.description: MACHINE_DECOMPOSED tasks are marked so the report can state which corpus was machine-authored; a machine-authored pool may not be presented as a confirmatory benchmark.

strata.description: Pre-treatment labels used for balanced assignment and for reporting where P1 works and fails. Assigned before any outcome is observed.
